findings.claim: The Task 5 aside claims that 'with a CATALOG_ADMIN_TOKEN-style name relaxed binding could even map it without a placeholder'. This is false: Spring Boot relaxed binding maps the property catalog.admin-token to the environment variable CATALOG_ADMINTOKEN (uppercase, dots to underscores, dashes REMOVED). CATALOG_ADMIN_TOKEN is adapted by the SystemEnvironmentPropertyMapper to the three-element name catalog.admin.token, which does not bind to the single element admin-token (canonical admintoken) of the CatalogProperties record. The module's own secrets-from-the-environment page teaches the correct rule ('uppercase the key, replace dots with underscores and remove dashes', e.g. spring.datasource.password -> SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD), so this README sentence contradicts the taught objective it reinforces.
findings.recommendation: Either delete the aside or correct the name: 'with relaxed binding, the environment variable CATALOG_ADMINTOKEN (dashes removed) could even map to catalog.admin-token without a placeholder'.

findings.claim: The javadoc says 'pageSize is an Integer so the application still starts while Task 2 has not set it yet', but catalog.page-size is set in Task 3 (Task 2 is the detail route and its 404). The README and application.properties both label the page-size work as Task 3.
